title: 统计道路上的碰撞次数
summary: 车辆向左、向右或静止；碰撞后相关移动车变静止，统计所有碰撞涉及的移动车数量。
insight: 最前面的连续向左车辆永远驶离，最后面的连续向右车辆也永远驶离。两者之间的每辆移动车最终都会撞上静止车辆或相向车辆，每辆恰贡献一次；统计中段非 S 字符即可。

solutions.title: 裁掉逃逸车辆后计数移动者
solutions.idea: 中间区域的所有移动趋势最终被阻断。
steps: left 跳过前缀 L，right 跳过后缀 R
字符不是 S 时 answer++

code.java: class Solution { public int countCollisions(String directions){int left=0,right=directions.length()-1;while(left<=right&&directions.charAt(left)=='L')left++;while(left<=right&&directions.charAt(right)=='R')right--;int answer=0;for(int i=left;i<=right;i++)if(directions.charAt(i)!='S')answer++;return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countCollisions(directions:String):Int{var left=0;var right=directions.lastIndex;while(left<=right&&directions[left]=='L')left++;while(left<=right&&directions[right]=='R')right--;var answer=0;for(i in left..right)if(directions[i]!='S')answer++;return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int countCollisions(string directions){int left=0,right=directions.size()-1;while(left<=right&&directions[left]=='L')++left;while(left<=right&&directions[right]=='R')--right;int answer=0;for(int i=left;i<=right;++i)answer+=directions[i]!='S';return answer;} };
